 WARNING  the vault's folder can be read by other accounts on
          this machine
          C:\data\sennit
  It lets in BUILTIN\Users. Sennit keeps every file it makes
  there for this account alone, but the folder shows what is
  there, and a file another program puts in it takes the
  folder's access. Sennit did not make this folder, so it leaves
  it as it was set.

 HINT     remove the other accounts from the folder's access
          list, under Security in its Properties
